boots-of-the-winding-path.name: Boots of the Winding Path
boots-of-the-winding-path.description: While wearing these boots, you can teleport as a Bonus Action up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that you occupied during the current turn.

dazzling-weapon.name: Dazzling Weapon
dazzling-weapon.description: The weapon grants +1 to its attack and damage rolls. It can shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. It has 4 charges: as a Reaction after you are hit, you can expend 1 to force a DC 15 Constitution saving throw; on a failure, the attacker has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. It regains 1d4 charges at dawn.

helm-of-awareness.name: Helm of Awareness
helm-of-awareness.description: While wearing this helm, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

manifold-tool.name: Manifold Tool
manifold-tool.description: As a Magic action, the tool transforms into the Artisan's Tools of your choice. You have proficiency with the chosen form while you use it.

mind-sharpener.name: Mind Sharpener
mind-sharpener.description: It has 4 charges. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can take a Reaction and expend 1 charge to succeed instead. It regains 1d4 charges at dawn.

repeating-shot.name: Repeating Shot
repeating-shot.description: The weapon grants +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls, ignores the Loading property, and produces its own magic ammunition if it is empty.

repulsion-shield.name: Repulsion Shield
repulsion-shield.description: It grants +1 to AC while you hold it. It has 4 charges: when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can expend 1 charge as a Reaction to push it up to 15 feet away. It regains 1d4 charges at dawn.

returning-weapon.name: Returning Weapon
returning-weapon.description: The weapon grants +1 to its attack and damage rolls and returns to your hand immediately after you use it to make a ranged attack. It applies only to a weapon with the Thrown property.

spell-refueling-ring.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
spell-refueling-ring.description: Requires Attunement by a spellcaster. As a Bonus Action, you recover one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. It can't be used again until the next dawn.
